semiconductor_relevance: High — Okuma Diamond Device is focused on developing diamond semiconductors, which are considered advanced materials in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Okuma Diamond Device is a specialist in the development and manufacturing of diamond semiconductors, aiming to establish a next-generation semiconductor industry in Japan. The company collaborates with government agencies to advance the practical application of diamond semiconductor technology.

regional_presence.Japan: The company is focused on establishing a next-generation semiconductor industry in Japan, supported by domestic research and government collaboration.
